narrative: The account book open on the parlour table. One new line, in Heminges's hand. Nothing under it. No sum in the margin.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the line and did not add a sum.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Had written the line. He did not write a share under it.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Navarre ended this day
